note: World outline colors for player silhouettes / nameplate trims. Blue-vs-vermillion axis (Okabe-Ito style) keeps friend/foe separable for protan/deutan/tritan; self and neutral differ by luminance. Pair color with a shape cue (enemy pulse, party pip) for accessibility. Ink under-stroke for all: #3B2433 at 1px.

self.desc: Your own character: warm sunny yellow, brightest.

neutral.desc: Neutral / unflagged players: soft lilac-grey (darker than self, so tritan eyes still split them).

enemy.desc: Hostile / enemy clan: vermillion (reads dark-olive to red-blind eyes, never confused with blue).
